scripts.build:ui: npm run check:contract && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:ui && mygo build -skip-build-command -platform darwin/arm64 -skip-dmg -skip-notarize
scripts.check: npm run build:ui && node --experimental-strip-types --test frontend/tests/*.test.mjs && GOWORK=off CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./... && GOWORK=off CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./...
